author: Kushal
problem: Read a string S of English letters in which exactly one letter is uppercase, and print the 1-based position of that letter.
bug_description: Uses strict 'A' < c < 'Z', so an uppercase A or Z is never detected.

comments.accurate: Prints the 1-based position of the uppercase letter in S
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints the 1-based position of each uppercase letter strictly between A and Z
comments.wrong_location: Uppercase range check verified; check the 1-based position offset
